Custom OpenCV.js single-file WASM calibration runtime, downloaded from the URL recorded in manifest.json. OpenCV Apache-2.0; build project MIT. Runtime bytes are pinned by SHA-256 and gzip-compressed with mtime=0, split only for repository transport. Concatenate parts in manifest order and gunzip to reproduce the original JS. The observed build uses OpenCV 5; source link describes upstream build but is not a reproducible-build attestation. Frames stay local. No runtime request to the upstream host is made.
